quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (April 2025 - March 2026): net sales JPY 384,247 million, down JPY 16,003 million (4.0%), as higher sales volumes of electronics and advanced products were offset by lower realized prices from price revisions following lower raw-material and fuel prices; operating income JPY 26,225 million (up JPY 11,811 million, 82.0%), ordinary income JPY 19,295 million (up 153.1%) and net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 15,695 million (prior year: a loss of JPY 12.3 billion), after an extraordinary loss related to the indefinitely suspended US subsidiary Denka Performance Elastomer offset by gains on the sale of the Ofuna plant site and of cross-held shares. Management states operating income exceeded the must-achieve target of JPY 25 billion, helped by portfolio transformation, cost reduction and capturing expanding AI-related and power-infrastructure demand in Electronics & Innovative Products.
quarterly_data.figure: net sales JPY 384,247 million (-4.0%); operating income JPY 26,225 million (+82.0%); net income JPY 15,695 million

quarterly_data.signal: Electronics & Innovative Products segment, FY2026: net sales JPY 104,430 million (up JPY 12,227 million, 13.3%) and operating income JPY 13,886 million (up JPY 4,717 million, 51.5%) as demand for AI-related and power-infrastructure applications expanded. Spherical silica and spherical alumina sales were strong on expanding demand for AI semiconductors; high-performance films rose as electronic-component demand slowly recovered; acetylene black rose overall as high-voltage cable sales exceeded the prior year while xEV sales fell; the high-reliability heat-dissipation plate ALSINK rose on recovering railway demand and growing demand for HVDC (direct-current transmission); sales of the new low-dielectric organic insulating resin SNECTON grew steadily.
quarterly_data.figure: segment net sales JPY 104,430 million (+13.3%); operating income JPY 13,886 million (+51.5%)

quarterly_data.signal: Other segments, FY2026: Life Innovation net sales JPY 40,520 million (down 6.3%), operating income JPY 6,247 million (down 34.9%) as POCT test-reagent volumes fell when infections subsided after the new year; Elastomers & Infrastructure Solutions net sales JPY 97,583 million (down 12.6%), operating income JPY 68 million (prior year: operating loss JPY 7,962 million) as profitability improved with the high-cost US chloroprene rubber plant suspended while chloroprene rubber demand stayed weak; Polymer Solutions net sales JPY 124,161 million (down 8.3%), operating income JPY 3,574 million (up 209.8%).
quarterly_data.figure: Life Innovation JPY 40,520 million; Elastomers & Infrastructure JPY 97,583 million; Polymer Solutions JPY 124,161 million

quarterly_data.signal: Revised Mission 2030 plan, Phase 2 (the company's fiscal 2026 - 2028, i.e. FY2027 - FY2029, years ending March 2027 - March 2029): the company aims to set a record operating income and reach ROE of 8% (in any year of Phase 2). Targets for FY2027 / FY2028 / FY2029: operating income JPY 35 billion / JPY 40 billion / JPY 45 billion; net income JPY 18 billion / JPY 22 billion / JPY 26 billion; ROE 6.0% / 7.0% / 8.0%; ROIC 5.0% / 5.5% / 6.0%; investment JPY 43 billion / JPY 34 billion / JPY 33 billion. The original plan had targeted operating income of JPY 60 billion in the company's fiscal 2026 (FY2027) and JPY 100 billion in fiscal 2030 (FY2031); Phase 1 (fiscal 2023 - 2025, i.e. FY2024 - FY2026) operating income was JPY 13.4 billion, JPY 14.4 billion and JPY 26.2 billion.
quarterly_data.figure: operating income targets JPY 35 billion / JPY 40 billion / JPY 45 billion (FY2027 / FY2028 / FY2029); ROE 8.0% target

quarterly_data.signal: Management states ICT & Energy is the growth driver: Denka will supply key materials in thermal management, keep top market shares and become the de facto standard in leading-edge fields such as AI and power infrastructure (megatrends listed: AI, high-speed communications, xEV, renewable energy, semiconductors). For the low-dielectric organic insulating resin SNECTON, where demand is expected in printed wiring boards and next-generation semiconductors, the company plans to expand the lineup by combining it with its own silica and alumina. Management cites as causes of the earlier profit decline about JPY 15 billion of higher fixed costs versus the fiscal year ended March 2022 (depreciation from upfront investment), the slump of the US chloroprene rubber business, shifts in semiconductor and EV electronic-materials demand, weaker styrenic resin demand and delays in new businesses.

Portfolio actions in FY2026: US subsidiary Denka Performance Elastomer suspended its chloroprene rubber plant indefinitely in May 2025 (removal and disposal of materials is in its final stage; further extraordinary losses are expected); cement production stopped in June 2025; the Ofuna plant closed in March 2026 with an exit from the colored film and tape business; in February 2026 the company decided to start considering a spin-off of its styrene-related business around April 2027; clinical-reagent maker Kainos became a subsidiary in March 2026. The company-wide cost-reduction project delivered JPY 3.7 billion in FY2026 (its second year) versus JPY 0.9 billion in FY2025.

FY2026 capital expenditure JPY 56,101 million, of which Electronics & Innovative Products JPY 37,947 million for AI-related semiconductors, power infrastructure and xEV: construction of the SNECTON low-dielectric organic insulating material plant at the Chiba plant, capacity expansion of the ALSINK high-reliability heat-dissipation plate at the Omuta plant, and an acetylene black plant at Thai subsidiary Denka SCGC Advanced Materials. Completed during the year: a next-generation high-performance spherical filler facility at the Omuta plant. Under Mission 2030 the company had planned JPY 540 billion of investment over eight years (including JPY 360 billion of strategic investment) and now targets a JPY 100 billion reduction, concentrating on selected projects.

quarterly_data.signal: Capex plan for the year after FY2026, i.e. FY2027 (new and expanded facilities): JPY 44,000 million in total - Electronics & Innovative Products JPY 25,000 million (expansion of electronic-material production facilities), Life Innovation JPY 2,000 million, Elastomers & Infrastructure Solutions JPY 10,000 million, Polymer Solutions JPY 7,000 million.
quarterly_data.figure: capex plan JPY 44,000 million; Electronics & Innovative Products JPY 25,000 million

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 R&D expenses JPY 14,768 million (849 researchers), of which Electronics & Innovative Products JPY 5,516 million. Themes: high-performance ceramic and organic-inorganic composite materials for circuit boards and heat-dissipation materials for power modules and vehicle electrification; higher-performance spherical silica for semiconductor encapsulants and spherical alumina for heat-dissipation materials; SNECTON low-dielectric organic insulating material for 5G and next-generation high-speed communications; sialon phosphors and nitrides for heat dissipation, and low-dielectric fillers; ultra-high-purity carbon black for lithium-ion batteries; dicing tape for die attach film (DAF) and a temporary bonding material (TBM) for electronic-device manufacturing.
